The plasma concentration of fentanyl may decrease when co-administered with CYP3A4 inducers like nafcillin, potentially leading to reduced efficacy or withdrawal symptoms in physically dependent patients. Conversely, discontinuing the inducer may increase fentanyl levels, prolonging both therapeutic and adverse effects. Close monitoring and therapy adjustments are recommended. 2. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of fentanyl transdermal and transmucosal formulations by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are advised. 3. Nafcillin decreases the plasma concentration of fesoterodine by enhancing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are necessary. 4. Nafcillin reduces the systemic exposure of flibanserin by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Strong CYP3A4 inducers significantly lower flibanserin levels. Caution and monitoring are required. 5. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of flurazepam by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. 6. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of fosamprenavir by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are necessary. 7. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of gefitinib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended. Increase gefitinib to 500 mg daily when co-administered with strong CYP3A4 inducers, and resume the standard dose 7 days after discontinuing the inducer. 8. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of glecaprevir/pibrentasvir by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism, potentially leading to therapeutic failure. Caution and monitoring are required. 9. Nafcillin decreases guanfacine levels and its elimination half-life by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. For ADHD patients, doubling the guanfacine dose may be necessary. Close monitoring and therapy adjustments are recommended. 10. Nafcillin reduces haloperidol levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. 11. Nafcillin and hydrochlorothiazide may increase each other's levels by reducing renal clearance. Caution and monitoring are necessary. 12. Nafcillin decreases hydrocodone levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Discontinuing CYP3A4 inducers may increase hydrocodone levels, risking fatal respiratory depression. Therapy modification and close monitoring are essential. 13. Nafcillin reduces hydroxyprogesterone caproate levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. 14. Nafcillin and IV ibuprofen may increase each other's levels by reducing renal clearance or through plasma protein binding competition. Caution and monitoring are necessary. 15. Nafcillin increases ifosfamide toxicity by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism, leading to increased formation of toxic metabolites like chloroacetaldehyde. Close monitoring for toxicities and dose adjustments are recommended. 16. Nafcillin and indapamide may increase each other's levels by reducing renal clearance. Caution and monitoring are necessary. 17. Nafcillin reduces indinavir levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. 18. Nafcillin decreases isosorbide dinitrate and mononitrate levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are required. 19. Nafcillin reduces isradipine levels by increasing its metabolism. Caution and monitoring are necessary. 20. Nafcillin decreases ixabepilone levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. 21. Nafcillin reduces lapatinib levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are necessary. 22. Nafcillin decreases levamlodipine levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Blood pressure should be closely monitored when co-administered with CYP3A4 inducers. 23. Nafcillin reduces levonorgestrel levels (both intrauterine and oral) by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism, potentially reducing contraceptive efficacy. Alternative or backup contraception is recommended during and for 28 days after discontinuing enzyme inducers. 24. Nafcillin decreases linagliptin levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Alternative treatments are strongly recommended. 25. Nafcillin reduces lomitapide levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. 26. Nafcillin decreases losartan levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are necessary. 27. Nafcillin reduces lurasidone levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Dose adjustments and close monitoring are recommended. 28. Nafcillin decreases maraviroc levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. 29. Nafcillin reduces marijuana levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are necessary. 30. Nafcillin decreases medroxyprogesterone levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism, potentially leading to contraceptive failure. Alternative methods are advised. 31. Nafcillin reduces mefloquine levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are required. 32. Nafcillin decreases mestranol levels or effects by altering intestinal flora or inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. The risk of contraceptive failure is low but caution is advised. 33. Nafcillin reduces methadone levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are necessary. 34. Nafcillin increases methotrexate levels by reducing renal clearance, potentially causing hematologic and gastrointestinal toxicity. Close monitoring is essential. 35. Nafcillin decreases midazolam levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. 36. Nafcillin reduces mifepristone levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Co-administration is not recommended by the manufacturer. 37. Nafcillin decreases naldemedine levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance of this reduction is unknown. Caution and monitoring are advised. 38. Nafcillin reduces nefazodone levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are necessary. 39. Nafcillin decreases nelfinavir levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. 40. Nafcillin reduces nevirapine levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are required. 41. Nafcillin decreases nicardipine levels by increasing its metabolism. Caution and monitoring are necessary. 42. Nafcillin reduces nifedipine levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended. 43. Nafcillin decreases nilotinib levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. 44. Nafcillin reduces nisoldipine levels by increasing its metabolism. Caution and monitoring are necessary. 45. Nafcillin decreases nivolumab effects through an unspecified mechanism, potentially interfering with immune checkpoint inhibitor efficacy. Caution and monitoring are advised. 46. Nafcillin reduces norethindrone levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Non-hormonal contraception is recommended during therapy. 47. Nafcillin decreases norgestrel levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Additional barrier methods are advised. 48. Nafcillin reduces oliceridine levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Dose adjustments and monitoring for opioid withdrawal or respiratory depression are recommended. 49. Nafcillin decreases osilodrostat levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Dose adjustments and close monitoring are necessary. 50. Nafcillin reduces oxycodone levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. 51. Nafcillin decreases palbociclib levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended. 52. Nafcillin reduces pazopanib levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are necessary. 53. Nafcillin decreases pembrolizumab effects through an unspecified mechanism, potentially interfering with immune checkpoint inhibitor efficacy. Caution and monitoring are advised. 54. Nafcillin reduces penpulimab effects through an unspecified mechanism, potentially interfering with immune checkpoint inhibitor efficacy. Caution and monitoring are necessary. 55. Nafcillin decreases pimavanserin levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration if possible. Dose adjustments and monitoring for reduced efficacy are recommended. 56. Nafcillin reduces pitolisant levels by 50% when co-administered with strong CYP3A4 inducers. Therapy modification and close monitoring are required. 57. Nafcillin decreases polatuzumab vedotin levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism, potentially reducing MMAE exposure. Caution and monitoring are advised. 58. Nafcillin reduces primaquine levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are necessary. 59. Probenecid increases nafcillin levels by reducing renal clearance. Caution and monitoring are advised. 60. Nafcillin decreases progesterone levels or effects (intravaginal gel, micronized, or natural forms) by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are necessary. 61. Nafcillin reduces quetiapine levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. 62. Nafcillin decreases quinidine levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are necessary. 63. Nafcillin reduces repaglinide levels or effects by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised.
